selection_policy.venue_requirement: Published/accepted at a recent top conference with public first-party code.
selection_policy.intervention_requirement: A non-tautological representation-identity intervention must enter the native execution path before behavior.
selection_policy.compute_policy: Run deterministic source/operator qualification before any provider or GPU experiment.

candidates.name: SAGE
evidence: Training initializes skill_libraries as empty per batch; the library is not the persistent learned state across batches.
Evaluation stores functions in an append-only list and retrieves by skill name with first-match semantics, so later same-name updates can be shadowed.
candidates.permitted_use: Structural comparator for formulation mismatch; not a native robustness carrier.

candidates.name: Dynamic Cheatsheet
evidence: The cumulative implementation maintains one monolithic cheatsheet string.
The curator consumes the whole prior string and returns the next whole string, leaving no observable item-identity intervention with a single-variable native path.
candidates.permitted_use: Structural comparator for an identity-free state representation.

candidates.name: ReasoningBank
evidence: Induction produces multiple memory items and persists them under one task/case record.
Retrieval selects whole case records; the rollout flattens each selected case's memory_items and joins them before agent.run.
DefaultAgent injects selected_memory into the first system message before the first model decision.
candidates.risk_boundary: Case-level top-n selection can expose fragmentation across case identities; item order remains observable.
candidates.authorized_next_step: Deterministic frozen-witness P0 only; no provider calls, GPU work, or behavior claim.

manuscript_policy: Do not modify the E1 main claim unless a separately registered behavioral propagation test passes.
